title: Anthropic Messages API — parsing a text response
pins: The parsed result produced from a raw Anthropic Messages body, with the USAGE ARITHMETIC as the reason the suite exists: the reasoning count Anthropic reports at usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens, the difference between that count being absent and being zero, and the cache counts Anthropic reports beside the prompt rather than inside it.
findings: G-48 — Anthropic reasoning tokens were dropped in ALL THREE languages until 2026-09-05: omitted in PHP, a literal null in TypeScript, hardcoded None in Python. Because the three AGREED, no cross-language comparison could see it, and the corpus asserted thought_tokens sixteen times without one of them being Anthropic. Reported by a human measuring the live API (Moic Suite, prism#33); this suite is the mechanical check that was missing. Goldens are generated from particle-academy/prism v0.117.0, the first release carrying the fix — generated against v0.116.0 they returned null for all five rows INCLUDING the one sending 1240, which is what a golden generated from a defective reference looks like. || G-49 — CLOSED the same day, and by this suite's FIRST run. Both ports returned an empty additional_content and agreed with EACH OTHER against the reference, which is the shape that says the reference is the outlier. It was the reference: extractCitations guarded on `content.*.citations === []`, and a wildcard yields one entry PER BLOCK — null where absent — so an ordinary answer produced [null], never [], and EVERY Anthropic response carried a citations entry holding an empty citation list and a copy of its own output text. Read the other way it looked like a missing port capability, and was filed as one for about an hour, until the guard was actually executed. Fixed in v0.117.1. || G-50 — CLOSED 2026-09-06. The suite's second run, after G-49 was fixed, left exactly one row disagreeing: a max_tokens finish, where both ports raised and the reference returned. Resolved by decision in favour of returning: the model wrote something usable, the tokens were paid for, and running out of room is exactly when the usage numbers matter most. The ports now match the reference for Anthropic and Mistral and still throw for OpenAI, because the reference's stance is per-PROVIDER rather than uniform — which is also why seventeen OpenAI rows never surfaced it: on OpenAI the ports were already correct, and no suite had a length row at all.
